anomalies.description: A dense cloud of white smoke (likely tear gas or smoke canisters) is deployed in a street crowd, causing people to disperse and react; police in riot gear are visible advancing behind the smoke, and individuals appear to be fleeing or shielding themselves.

Police officers in full riot gear, many on bicycles, form a line across a city street, facing a crowd; the scene transitions from active smoke deployment to a standoff posture, indicating organized crowd control during unrest.
A police officer appears to physically engage with a cyclist, leading to the cyclist falling and the bike being thrown; motion blur and posture suggest forceful contact.

After the cyclist falls (f4–f5), an officer stands over the downed individual while the bike lies on the ground; the person appears incapacitated and not resisting, suggesting potential abuse during restraint or post-fall handling.
Sudden deployment of a large cloud of smoke (likely tear gas or smoke canister) in the street, causing crowd dispersal and visible distress; police in riot gear are present and advancing.

Sudden onset of dense smoke (likely tear gas or smoke canisters) in a street crowd, followed by chaotic movement, people covering faces, and apparent confrontation between individuals and uniformed officers; consistent with a riot or violent dispersal.

Multiple individuals engaged in close physical struggle amid smoke; one person in blue appears to be grappling or striking another near a bicycle, while others intervene or push—suggesting mutual physical combat.

A large group of individuals, many in dark tactical gear and on bicycles, are gathered in a street intersection; a bicycle lies on the ground in the crosswalk, and movement suggests active confrontation or dispersal. The scene evolves from a relatively static line of officers (f0) to dynamic motion with people advancing/retreating and a flag being waved (f7–f14), consistent with collective violent unrest or violent group clashes.; Sudden onset of dense white smoke (likely tear gas or smoke canisters) in the street, causing a crowd to scatter and run; individuals are seen fleeing, some with hands covering faces, amid chaotic movement and obscured visibility.

A crowd of people is seen reacting to a sudden release of smoke or tear gas in an urban street setting; individuals are running, ducking, and dispersing rapidly while smoke billows across the intersection. The presence of black-clad individuals, some holding flags, and the chaotic movement indicate collective violent unrest or confrontation.; A dense crowd of people, many in dark clothing, is gathered in a street intersection with visible smoke or tear gas in the air (especially in f0). The group appears to be moving collectively and confrontationally toward a line of uniformed officers on bicycles, suggesting violent unrest or clash.

In frames f3–f5, multiple individuals appear engaged in close physical contact: one person in white shirt is grabbed/pushed by others, and there is visible shoving and grappling amid the smoke. While obscured, the motion suggests mutual physical combat rather than mere crowd movement.

After the initial smoke event, the scene shifts to a street corner where a large group of people—some on bicycles—converge and move aggressively toward a building with a lit sign (‘Pino’s’). Traffic lights are red, yet the group advances en masse across the crosswalk, indicating coordinated disruptive action consistent with riotous behavior.

A line of police officers on bicycles advances across the intersection, pushing back the crowd. Vehicles are present near the confrontation, and the scene remains chaotic with motion blur indicating rapid movement and tension. This constitutes a violent group clash between protesters and law enforcement.

Sudden appearance of dense white smoke (likely tear gas or smoke canisters) in the street, causing crowd dispersal and chaotic movement; individuals are seen reacting, covering faces, and moving away rapidly amid visible police presence and protest signage.; A chaotic street scene with dense smoke (likely tear gas or smoke canisters) filling the air, people running and dispersing, and a cameraperson filming amid the commotion; consistent with violent unrest or clash between groups.; A line of heavily equipped police officers on bicycles forms a barrier across the street, facing a crowd; this is a tactical response to ongoing unrest, following the earlier smoke and dispersal, indicating sustained riot conditions.
